<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<!--
  Sandbox probe for a course file. This is text on purpose.
  Copy it, rename the copy to evil-test.html, upload that copy
  through Files, and open it after typing "I am sure".

  FAIL means this tab could read or call the course as the logged-in user.
  PASS means that attempt was blocked.
  INFO means the tab did something it is allowed to do, such as run script.

  The address bar host is used on purpose. Inside the sandbox,
  location.origin is the string "null", which would miss the course.
  The session cookie is HttpOnly, so an empty document.cookie is not proof.

  Nothing here is sent to another server. The POST path does not exist.
-->
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>evil-test</title>
<style>
body { font-family: sans-serif; margin: 1.5rem; line-height: 1.4; }
table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; margin-top: 1rem; }
th, td { border: 1px solid #ccc; padding: 0.4rem; vertical-align: top; text-align: left; }
code { white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; }
.PASS, .FAIL { font-weight: 700; }
iframe { width: 100%; height: 6rem; border: 1px solid #ccc; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<h1>evil-test</h1>
<p>This page tries to use the course login from an uploaded file. FAIL means it could act as you.</p>
<p id="summary">running</p>
<table>
<thead><tr><th>Status</th><th>Probe</th><th>Result</th></tr></thead>
<tbody id="results"></tbody>
</table>
<h2>Form POST</h2>
<iframe name="probe-frame" title="form probe"></iframe>
<script>
(function () {
    var rows = [];
    var tbody = document.getElementById('results');
    var summary = document.getElementById('summary');
    var site = location.protocol + '//' + location.host;
    var counts = { PASS: 0, FAIL: 0, INFO: 0 };

    function textOf(value) {
        if (typeof value === 'string') return value;
        try { return JSON.stringify(value); } catch (e) { return String(value); }
    }

    function report(status, probe, result) {
        counts[status] += 1;
        rows.push(status);
        var tr = document.createElement('tr');
        [status, probe, textOf(result)].forEach(function (value, index) {
            var td = document.createElement('td');
            if (index === 0) td.className = status;
            var code = document.createElement('code');
            code.textContent = value;
            td.appendChild(code);
            tr.appendChild(td);
        });
        tbody.appendChild(tr);
        summary.textContent = 'PASS ' + counts.PASS + ' | FAIL ' + counts.FAIL + ' | INFO ' + counts.INFO;
    }

    function attempt(probe, fn, judge) {
        var settled = false;
        function finish(value, threw) {
            if (settled) return;
            settled = true;
            var verdict = 'INFO';
            try { verdict = judge(value, threw); } catch (e) { verdict = 'INFO'; }
            if (verdict !== 'PASS' && verdict !== 'FAIL') verdict = 'INFO';
            report(verdict, probe, threw ? value : value);
        }
        try {
            var out = fn();
            if (out && typeof out.then === 'function') {
                out.then(function (value) { finish(value, false); }, function (err) {
                    finish(String(err && err.message ? err.message : err), true);
                });
            } else {
                finish(out, false);
            }
        } catch (err) {
            finish(String(err && err.message ? err.message : err), true);
        }
    }

    report('INFO', 'address bar', location.href);
    report('INFO', 'window.origin', String(window.origin));
    report('INFO', 'host used for probes', site);

    try {
        var cookie = document.cookie;
        if (cookie) {
            report('FAIL', 'document.cookie', cookie);
        } else {
            report('INFO', 'document.cookie', '(empty) The session cookie is HttpOnly, so this can be empty even when the sandbox is off.');
        }
    } catch (e) {
        report('PASS', 'document.cookie', String(e.message || e));
    }

    try {
        localStorage.setItem('evil-test', '1');
        localStorage.removeItem('evil-test');
        report('INFO', 'localStorage', 'This tab can use storage. A sandboxed tab gets its own empty jar, not the course jar.');
    } catch (e) {
        report('INFO', 'localStorage', String(e.message || e));
    }

    try {
        var before = document.domain;
        var parts = before.split('.');
        if (parts.length >= 2 && before) {
            document.domain = parts.slice(-2).join('.');
            report('FAIL', 'document.domain', 'relaxed to ' + document.domain);
        } else if (!before) {
            report('PASS', 'document.domain', 'no site domain to join');
        } else {
            report('INFO', 'document.domain', before + ' has no parent domain to join');
        }
    } catch (e) {
        report('PASS', 'document.domain', String(e.message || e));
    }

    try {
        report('INFO', 'eval', String(eval('21+21')) === '42' ? 'Script ran. This download allows script in its own tab.' : 'eval returned something else');
    } catch (e) {
        report('INFO', 'eval', String(e.message || e));
    }

    attempt('credentialed GET of this site', function () {
        return fetch(site + '/', { method: 'GET', credentials: 'include' }).then(function (response) {
            return response.text().then(function (body) {
                return { status: response.status, body: body.slice(0, 180).replace(/\s+/g, ' ') };
            });
        });
    }, function (value, threw) {
        return threw ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL';
    });

    attempt('credentialed POST /evil-test-probe', function () {
        return fetch(site + '/evil-test-probe', {
            method: 'POST',
            credentials: 'include',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
            body: 'probe=1'
        }).then(function (response) {
            return { status: response.status };
        });
    }, function (value, threw) {
        return threw ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL';
    });

    attempt('XHR with credentials', function () {
        return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
            xhr.open('GET', site + '/', true);
            xhr.withCredentials = true;
            xhr.onload = function () { resolve({ status: xhr.status, body: (xhr.responseText || '').slice(0, 120) }); };
            xhr.onerror = function () { reject(new Error('XHR failed')); };
            xhr.send();
        });
    }, function (value, threw) {
        return threw ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL';
    });

    attempt('service worker on this site', function () {
        if (!navigator.serviceWorker) return Promise.reject(new Error('no service worker API'));
        return navigator.serviceWorker.register(site + '/evil-test-sw.js');
    }, function (value, threw) {
        return threw ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL';
    });

    try {
        var popup = window.open('about:blank', '_blank');
        if (!popup) {
            report('INFO', 'popup', 'The browser blocked the popup. This download is allowed to open one.');
        } else {
            report('INFO', 'popup', 'A blank popup opened. It is not the course session.');
            try { popup.close(); } catch (e) { /* leave it */ }
        }
    } catch (e) {
        report('INFO', 'popup', String(e.message || e));
    }

    var form = document.createElement('form');
    form.method = 'post';
    form.action = site + '/evil-test-probe';
    form.target = 'probe-frame';
    var input = document.createElement('input');
    input.type = 'hidden';
    input.name = 'probe';
    input.value = '1';
    form.appendChild(input);
    document.body.appendChild(form);
    form.submit();
    report('INFO', 'form POST', 'Submitted to ' + site + '/evil-test-probe. That path does not exist. Check the request in the network panel for a session cookie.');
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
